32.word_for_word: एवं कारणसृष्टिमुक्त्वा कार्यसृष्टिमाह । — Thus, after explaining the creation of cause, he describes the creation of action.; यदा एते असङ्गता अमीलिता आसन्, अत एव यदा आयतनस्य शरीरस्य निर्माणे न शेकुः ॥३२॥ — When these incompatibilities were not closed, that is why they could not form the body of volume.
32.translation: Thus, after explaining the creation of cause, he describes the creation of action. When these incompatibilities were not closed, that is why they could not form the body of volume.

33.word_for_word: तदा सदसत्त्वं प्रधानगुणभावमुपादाय स्वीकृत्य । — Then, having accepted the good and the evil as the principal modes of nature,; उभयं समष्टिव्यष्ट्यात्मकं शरीरम् ॥३३॥ — Both are the body composed of the whole and the individual.
33.translation: Then, having accepted the good and the evil as the principal modes of nature, Both are the body composed of the whole and the individual.

34.word_for_word: कालकर्मस्वभावानधिष्ठाय स्थितो जीवयतीति जीवः परमात्मा अजीवमचेतनमजीवयच्चेतयति स्म ॥३४॥ — The living entity, the Supreme Soul, assuming the nature of time and action, thus giving life, gave life to the inanimate and the unconscious.
34.translation: The living entity, the Supreme Soul, assuming the nature of time and action, thus giving life, gave life to the inanimate and the unconscious.

35.word_for_word: निर्भिद्य पृथक्कृत्य स्थित इत्यर्थः ॥३५॥ — It means to break and separate and stand.
35.translation: It means to break and separate and stand.

36.word_for_word: तदवयवैर्लोकरचनामाह—यस्येति । — He describes the structure of the world by its components; कटिरित्यूर्मूलयोः पश्चाद्भागः । — The waist is the posterior part of the roots.; जघनं पुरोभागः । — The hips are the front part.; अधः सप्तलोकानतलादीन् । — Below are the seven worlds, the bottom and the others.; ऊर्ध्वं भूरादीन् सप्त ॥३६॥ — above the seven earth and others.
36.translation: He describes the structure of the world by its components The waist is the posterior part of the roots. The hips are the front part. Below are the seven worlds, the bottom and the others. above the seven earth and others.

37.word_for_word: वर्णानां तत उत्पत्तिं दर्शयति—पुरुषस्येति । — He then shows the origin of the varnas—that of the Puruṣa.; ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणो मुखम् इति कार्य-कारणयोर् अभेद-विवक्षयोक्तम् । — Brahman is the mouth of the Brahman, as stated in the distinction between cause and effect.; बाहव इति च । — and arms, etc.; क्षत्रं क्षत्रियः ॥३७॥ — The Kshatriyas are the Kshatriyas.
37.translation: He then shows the origin of the varnas—that of the Puruṣa. Brahman is the mouth of the Brahman, as stated in the distinction between cause and effect. and arms, etc. The Kshatriyas are the Kshatriyas.

38.word_for_word: इदानीम् उपासनार्थं लोक-कल्पना-भेदान् दर्शयन् सप्त-लोक-पक्षम् आह द्वाभ्याम् । — Now, showing the differences in the imagination of the worlds for worship, he describes the seven worlds in two ways.; भूर्-लोकः पातालम् आरभ्य । — Bhur-loka, starting with the underworld.; पद्भ्यां कटि-पर्यन्ताभ्याम् ॥३८॥ — with feet up to the waist.
38.translation: Now, showing the differences in the imagination of the worlds for worship, he describes the seven worlds in two ways. Bhur-loka, starting with the underworld. with feet up to the waist.

39.word_for_word: स्तन-द्वयाद् इत्य् उपासनार्थत्वाद् ऊर्ध्वाधो-भाग-वैपरीत्यं न दोषः । — Since the two breasts are for the purpose of worship, there is nothing wrong with the opposite of the upper and lower parts.; यद् वा, स्तनच्-छब्दं कुर्वद् यद् ओष्ठ-द्वयं तस्माद् इत्य् अर्थः । — or, that is, from the two lips which make the sound of the breast.; ब्रह्म-लोको वैकुण्ठाख्यः, सनातनो नित्यः, न तु सृज्य-प्रपञ्चान्तर्वर्तीत्य् अर्थः ॥३९॥ — This means that the world of Brahman is called Vaikuntha, eternal and everlasting, and does not exist within the world of creation.
39.translation: Since the two breasts are for the purpose of worship, there is nothing wrong with the opposite of the upper and lower parts. or, that is, from the two lips which make the sound of the breast. This means that the world of Brahman is called Vaikuntha, eternal and everlasting, and does not exist within the world of creation.

40.word_for_word: इदानीं चतुर्दश-लोक-पक्षं दर्शयति । — Now it shows the aspect of the fourteen worlds.; तत्र जघनादिभिर् भूरादयः पूर्वोक्ता एव सप्त, कट्य्-आदिभिर् अधः सप्त-लोकान् आह—तत्-कट्याम् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — There, by the hips and others, the earth and others are the same as mentioned above, and below the waist and others, he says, the seven worlds—that in the waist, by two.; शुद्धं हरि-भक्त-निवासत्वात् ॥४०-४१॥ — It is pure because it is the abode of the devotees of Hari.40-4
40.translation: Now it shows the aspect of the fourteen worlds. There, by the hips and others, the earth and others are the same as mentioned above, and below the waist and others, he says, the seven worlds—that in the waist, by two. It is pure because it is the abode of the devotees of Hari.40-4

41.word_for_word: इदानीं चतुर्दश-लोक-पक्षं दर्शयति । — Now it shows the aspect of the fourteen worlds.; तत्र जघनादिभिर् भूरादयः पूर्वोक्ता एव सप्त, कट्य्-आदिभिर् अधः सप्त-लोकान् आह—तत्-कट्याम् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — There, by the hips and others, the earth and others are the same as mentioned above, and below the waist and others, he says, the seven worlds—that in the waist, by two.; शुद्धं हरि-भक्त-निवासत्वात् ॥४०-४१॥ — It is pure because it is the abode of the devotees of Hari.40-4
41.translation: Now it shows the aspect of the fourteen worlds. There, by the hips and others, the earth and others are the same as mentioned above, and below the waist and others, he says, the seven worlds—that in the waist, by two. It is pure because it is the abode of the devotees of Hari.40-4

42.word_for_word: त्रि-लोक-पक्षम् आह । — He argues for the three-world side.; भूर्-लोकः पातालादि-सहितः ॥४२॥ — The earthly world with the underworld and others.
42.translation: He argues for the three-world side. The earthly world with the underworld and others.
